name: 3rd Dan

practical.title: Choi-Jong
practical.detail: 46 movements. Starts from closed ready stance C; ends with right foot returning to ready posture. Named after General Choi Yong, a 14th-century Koryo commander respected for loyalty and humility.

practical.title: Sam-IL
practical.detail: 33 movements. Starts from closed ready stance C; ends with a low front snap kick and twin vertical punch with stamp, then return to ready posture. Refers to the 1 March 1919 independence movement; 33 movements for the 33 patriots.

practical.title: Yoo-Sin
practical.detail: 68 movements. Starts from warrior ready stance B; ends with right foot returning to ready posture. Named after General Kim Yoo Sin of the Silla Dynasty; 68 refers to 668 AD, the year Korea was unified. The warrior ready stance represents a sword drawn on the right, symbolising his error in following his king's orders to fight alongside a foreign force against his own nation.
